attribution.note: Win rate by input tertile, pick-side relative. |spread| = high-band win rate minus low-band — bigger magnitude = the metric separates winners from losers harder, and deserves weight. Read direction too: a NEGATIVE spread on a should-be-positive factor is a red flag.

kprops.note: Bias = actual minus projection (positive means we under-project). Leans only counted at 0.7+ strikeout edges. Small samples early — a lean record means little before ~100 graded pitchers.

recommendations: Full-history record across every analyzed game (all tiers, all dates): 203-152 (57.2%), n=355. This is what the correlations below are measured against -- not just the 22 current-model official picks.
Lab Rating's conviction component score: r=0.107 (n=355) -- a modest relationship. Bottom quarter (0.00 to 2.16): 45-43 (51.1%). Top quarter (20.00 to 35.00): 59-32 (64.8%).
LyDia's own win probability for this pick: r=0.097 (n=355) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.44 to 0.54): 44-44 (50.0%). Top quarter (0.70 to 0.74): 55-36 (60.4%).

Team strength blend edge, before any pitcher/bullpen adjustment (picked side minus opponent): r=0.076 (n=210) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (-0.19 to -0.06): 29-23 (55.8%). Top quarter (0.08 to 0.23): 34-20 (63.0%).
Lab Rating's offense component score: r=0.063 (n=355) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.00 to 12.48): 51-37 (58.0%). Top quarter (25.00 to 50.00): 58-33 (63.7%).

Size of the price (how big a favorite or underdog this pick was): r=-0.062 (n=349) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (100.00 to 115.00): 47-40 (54.0%). Top quarter (159.00 to 850.00): 53-35 (60.2%).
Probability points bullpen risk moved this pick's number: r=-0.056 (n=355) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (-0.14 to -0.03): 53-35 (60.2%). Top quarter (0.05 to 0.17): 48-43 (52.7%).
Pick tier (official / value watch / watchlist / pass): official_pick 18-10 (64.3%, n=28) vs. watchlist 33-22 (60.0%, n=55) vs. value_watch 3-2 (60.0%, n=5) vs. pass 149-118 (55.8%, n=267).
Picked the home team vs. the road team: Home 121-77 (61.1%, n=198) vs. Road 82-75 (52.2%, n=157).
These are correlations across LyDia's own analyzed history, not causal proof and not a signal to change any model weight or gate on their own -- human review still required for any actual change.
